title: Gary Klein with Paul Sonkin and Paul Johnson – Conducting Pre-Mortem Analysis (Capital Allocators, EP.109)

reader_summary.headline: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators.
reader_summary.overview: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators. This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. Through conversations with leaders in the money game, we learn how these holders of the keys to the kingdom allocate their time and their capital.

key_points.text: Over his 40-year career in the field, he's pioneered the field of naturalistic decision-making, the premortem method of risk assessment.
key_points.evidence_quote: Over his 40-year career in the field, he's pioneered the field of naturalistic decision-making, the premortem method of risk assessment, and the Shadowbox training approach.

thesis: The speakers discuss how expertise is built through tacit knowledge rather than following rules or procedures in ambiguous situations. They argue that experts do not generate many options or use standard evaluation dimensions but instead use experience to quickly size up situations and determine what to do.
